questions: Are there any good parks for birdwatching?
Mistral-7B:
Yes, Tolowa Dunes State Park is known for its rich birdlife. Several species of woodpeckers, including the pileated woodpecker, can be found in the park. Migratory birds, such as ducks, geese, and swans, use the park as a stopover on the Pacific flyway. Rare species like the Canada Aleutian goose and Peregrine falcon can also be spotted. The Smith River and the lake areas offer opportunities to see salmon, steelhead, cutthroat trout, and other fish species. For more information, visit the park's website: <https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=430>.
